opportunities.name: City weekend trip planning and emailing
opportunities.description: For a given city and dates, gather population (Wikipedia), weather (timeanddate), hotel (Booking), activities (Viator), dinner (restaurant site), then save a note and draft an email to a friend.
opportunities.site: wikipedia, timeanddate, booking, viator, co (restaurant booking), notes, mail
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia and open the article for population
Search the city on timeanddate and open the Weather page
On Booking enter the destination, pick the city option, select check-in/out dates, set travelers if needed, and search
On Viator search for activity 1 and open a top result, then search for activity 2 and open a top result
On the restaurant site enter 'city cuisine', pick the date and party size, click Find a table, open a restaurant
In Notes create a new note summarizing city, dates, population, temperature, hotel and price, activities and dinner
In Mail compose to the friend with subject and body summarizing the plan, then discard
